question: An employee connects their entire work Google Drive so that Claude can help with the files in one project folder. What is the greatest risk?
options: A) The files are copied into training data, because connected sources bypass the account's privacy settings.
B) The connection makes the files editable by anyone in the organisation who opens the same project.
C) Colleagues who cannot open those files in Drive will now be able to read them through the connector.
D) Everything they can already open in Drive becomes reachable in Claude, far beyond the folder they need.
correct_answers: D) Everything they can already open in Drive becomes reachable in Claude, far beyond the folder they need.
explanations: Connecting a source does not place its files into model training.
A connection does not change who may edit files in the underlying service.
Connectors respect the source system's permissions, so they cannot widen access for other people.
Correct. A connector inherits the person's own access, so an unscoped connection exposes far more than intended.
